newsitem.title: USA: American Comms offers local phone service.
newsitem.headline: American Comms offers local phone service.

text.p: American Communications Services Inc said Monday it is launching competitive local dial tone service for business customers in 15 cities of the BellSouth Corp region.
The company said their local service rollout was one of the largest efforts by a competitive local telephone provider since passage of the Telecommunications Act of 1996.
American Communications' local services will be available in eight states.
The company now provides competitive switched dial tone over its own facilities in Columbus, Ga., and Montgomery, Ala.

It said it expects to offer service over its own facilities in Louisville, Ky., and Birmingham, Ala., shortly. Through a resale pact with BellSouth, American Communications said it has expanded the service offering in those markets.

It also introduced competitive local telephone service in Mobile, Ala., Jacksonville, Fla., Baton Rouge, New Orleans and Shreveport, La., Jackson, Miss., and Charleston, Columbia, Greenville and Spartanburg, S.C., and Chattanooga, Tenn.
The company already operates all-digital, fiber optic networks in each of its markets. It said it has 24 local networks operating and 12 under construction.
